name: Harness
description: AI-powered coding workspace with Monaco Editor, DeepSeek agent loop, built-in browser, and sub-agent delegation

scripts.desktop:dev: set ELECTRON_DEV=1&& concurrently "cd client && vite --config vite.config.ts" "electron electron/main.cjs"
scripts.desktop:pack: npm run icon:generate && npm run desktop:build && electron-builder --win --dir && node scripts/embed-icon.js && electron-builder --win --prepackaged dist/win-unpacked
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd client && npm install
scripts.postinstall: node -e "try { const { spawnSync } = require('child_process'); const r1 = spawnSync('npx', ['electron-rebuild','--only','better-sqlite3'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); const r2 = spawnSync('npx', ['electron-rebuild','--only','node-pty'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); if (r2.status !== 0) { console.warn('node-pty rebuild failed; terminal will fall back to pipe mode.'); } } catch(e) { console.warn('electron-rebuild skipped; terminal will fall back to pipe mode.'); }"
